from language import load, validate, MAX_NODES, MAX_DEPTH, MAX_STEPS, MAX_BYTES
from checker import check
from interpreter import run
import json
t=open('/app/witness.json').read()
p=load(t)                      # structural validity (dup keys / nonfinite / names / arities)
n=validate(p)                   # node count + depth enforcement
r=run(p)
print('accepted        :', check(p))
print('status          :', r['status'], '|', r.get('message'))
print('steps           :', r['steps'], '<=', MAX_STEPS)
print('nodes           :', n, '<=', MAX_NODES)
print('file bytes      :', len(t.encode()), '<=', MAX_BYTES)
print('max block size  :', max(len(b) for b in [p['body']]+[s[2] for s in p['body'] if s[0]=='repeat']))
print('depth ok        :', MAX_DEPTH)
EOF
